provenance: Constructed locally for this experiment. Intended meanings reviewed by the coding assistant, not independently human-certified. Never use this held-out file for calibration/training.

cases.source: 优惠85折，不包邮。
cases.meaning: Pay 85% of original price (15% off); shipping is not included.

cases.source: 原价200元，八五折后170元，便宜30元。
cases.meaning: Original 200 yuan, final 170 after 15% discount, saving 30.

cases.source: 第二件半价，不是两件都半价。
cases.meaning: Only the second item is half price, not both.

cases.source: 请先退款，不要补发。
cases.meaning: Please refund first; do not send a replacement.

cases.source: 收到坏的配件后，我们会免费补发新的。
cases.meaning: After we receive the defective accessory, we will send a new one free.

cases.source: 你把坏的退给我，我把新的寄给你。
cases.meaning: You return the defective item to me; I send the new item to you.

cases.source: 不是没货，是暂时不能发俄罗斯。
cases.meaning: It is in stock, but temporarily cannot be shipped to Russia.

cases.source: 不是充电器坏了，是线没插紧。
cases.meaning: The charger is not broken; the cable is not plugged in firmly.

cases.source: 一箱24个，一共5箱，不是5个。
cases.meaning: 24 items per carton, five cartons total, not five items.

cases.source: 外径80毫米，内径76毫米，误差不超过0.2毫米。
cases.meaning: Outside diameter 80 mm, inside 76 mm, tolerance at most 0.2 mm.

cases.source: 容量500毫升，净重不是500克。
cases.meaning: Capacity 500 ml; this does not mean a net weight of 500 g.

cases.source: 订金可以退，定制开工后不退。
cases.meaning: Deposit is refundable before customized work starts; not after it starts.

cases.source: 今天付款，后天发货，不是后天到货。
cases.meaning: Pay today, ship the day after tomorrow; arrival is not promised then.

cases.source: 我们承担寄回运费，您承担第一次寄出的运费。
cases.meaning: We pay return shipping; you pay the initial outbound shipping.

cases.source: 免费安装不包括上楼搬运。
cases.meaning: Free installation excludes carrying the item upstairs.

cases.source: 这笔是开机费，不是运费。
cases.meaning: This charge is a machine setup/start-up charge, not shipping.

cases.source: 高度可以调节，亮度不能调节。
cases.meaning: Height is adjustable; brightness is not.

cases.source: 适用于iPhone 18 promax，支持Magsafe，17pro不能用。
cases.meaning: Suitable for iPhone 18 promax, supports Magsafe; not compatible with 17pro.

cases.source: USB-C输入5V/3A，输出最大20W，电池不含在内。
cases.meaning: USB-C input 5V/3A, output up to 20W; battery not included.

cases.source: 先不要确认收货，等补发件到了再确认。
cases.meaning: Do not confirm receipt yet; confirm after the replacement arrives.

cases.source: 不是让您再付135元，是退您135元。
cases.meaning: You are not being asked to pay another 135 yuan; 135 yuan is being refunded to you.

cases.source: 最低3000件，每种颜色至少500件。
cases.meaning: At least 3000 items total and at least 500 of each color.

cases.source: 发错颜色可以换，不是质量问题也可以换。
cases.meaning: Wrong colors may be exchanged; an exchange is also possible without a quality defect.

cases.source: 价格不含税，含税需要另外加13%。
cases.meaning: Price excludes tax; tax-inclusive price requires an additional 13%.
